jsonld_raw.name: MYRRH AND FIG SCENT DIFFUSER 90ML (3.04 FL.OZ).
jsonld_raw.description:
MYRRH AND FIG SCENT DIFFUSER 90ML (3.04 FL.OZ). Home fragrance diffuser to transform your space into an enveloping atmosphere. Inspired by the light, scents, and leisurely pace of a summer in Greece. The juicy sweetness of lychee provides a delicate luminosity, while myrrh reveals a warm, sophisticated facet. Vanilla envelops the composition with a creamy softness that turns the room into a cozy and relaxing retreat.

A collection created by Ms. Jo Malone CBE, founder of Jo Loves.

Floral fruity | Warm, comforting, and sweet
